name: imvia-studio
description: Independent local IMVIA Studio MCP with first-run cross-platform Lovart onboarding and explicit creation controls.

interface.shortDescription: Local workbench with independent Lovart onboarding.
interface.longDescription: IMVIA Studio provides isolated local MCP, JSON state, task lifecycle, managed result import, loopback HTTP/SSE services, a bundled cross-platform secure Lovart onboarding flow, and explicit creation/cost confirmation controls. The existing Lovart plugin remains independent.
